atena_wasd.speaker: Atena
atena_wasd.text: What calls your spirit to action on this lovely day?

atena_wasd.speaker: Prometej
atena_wasd.text: I want to bring fire to the people!

atena_wasd.speaker: Atena
atena_wasd.text: I shall guide you on your travels.

atena_wasd.speaker: Atena
atena_wasd.text: You can move using the A and D keys.

atena_wasd.speaker: Atena
atena_wasd.text: To jump, use W or SPACE.
